issues.legal_issue: An appeal filed out of time with an application to condone delay remains an appeal even when it is disposed of without a hearing on the merits.
material_facts: A defendant filed an appeal against an ex parte decree together with an application to condone delay.
The application concerning the delayed appeal and the appeal were dismissed for default before the application to set aside the ex parte decree was decided.
issues.conclusion: An appeal does not cease to be an appeal because it was filed out of time or was disposed of on a preliminary ground rather than on its merits.
issues.legal_principle: Under Sections 3 and 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963, and Order XLI Rule 3A of the Code of Civil Procedure, an appeal presented out of time is still an appeal, and its dismissal following refusal to condone delay is a decision in the appeal. The Court relied on Nagendra Nath Dey v. Suresh Chandra Dey, Raja Kulkarni v. State of Bombay, Mela Ram and Sons v. Commissioner of Income Tax, Sheodan Singh v. Daryao Kunwar, Board of Revenue v. Raj Brothers Agencies, and Thambi v. Mathew. It held that Ratansingh v. Vijaysingh did not state the correct law on this point because it did not account for the relevant earlier authorities.

rule.if: civil_appeal_proceeding and appeal_filed_out_of_time and delay_condonation_request_made and appeal_disposed_without_merits

predicates.civil_appeal_proceeding: A party brought a civil appeal seeking to challenge a lower court's decision.
predicates.appeal_filed_out_of_time: The party submitted the appeal after the applicable filing period had expired.
predicates.delay_condonation_request_made: The party asked the court to excuse the late filing of the appeal.
predicates.appeal_disposed_without_merits: The appellate proceeding ended on a preliminary ground or for default without a decision on the substantive merits.

issues.definition: When a civil appeal is filed late with a request to excuse the delay and is disposed of without a merits decision, it remains an appeal for legal purposes.

issues.legal_issue: A defendant who has appealed an ex parte decree and whose appeal is disposed of without being withdrawn cannot later pursue an application to set aside that decree under the applicable procedural rule.
material_facts: A defendant was proceeded against in his absence and an ex parte decree was entered against him.
The defendant first applied to set aside the decree and later filed an appeal against it while that application remained pending.
The appeal was dismissed for default before the application to set aside the decree was decided, and the defendant had not withdrawn the appeal.
The application to set aside the decree was considered after the appeal had been dismissed.
issues.conclusion: The explanation to Order IX Rule 13 barred the application to set aside the ex parte decree, even though the application was filed before the appeal and the appeal was dismissed for default rather than decided on its merits.
issues.legal_principle: The explanation to Order IX Rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure provides that, where an appeal has been taken against an ex parte decree and disposed of on a ground other than withdrawal, an application under that rule to set aside the decree shall not lie. Applying Rani Choudhury v. Lt.-Col. Suraj Jit Choudhury and P. Kiran Kumar v. A.S. Khadar, the Court held that disposal on any ground other than withdrawal attracts the bar; a merits decision or merger of the decree is not required. The rule aims to confine the defendant to a single course of challenge and applies regardless of whether the application or appeal was filed first.

rule.if: ex_parte_decree_proceeding and set_aside_request_filed and appeal_filed_against_decree and appeal_disposed_without_withdrawal

predicates.ex_parte_decree_proceeding: A court entered a decree against a defendant after proceeding in the defendant's absence.
predicates.set_aside_request_filed: The defendant asked the court that entered the decree to set it aside.
predicates.appeal_filed_against_decree: The defendant filed an appeal challenging that decree.
predicates.appeal_disposed_without_withdrawal: The appeal ended for a reason other than the appellant withdrawing it, including dismissal for default or on a preliminary ground.

issues.definition: In an ex parte decree proceeding, a filed request to set aside the decree is barred when the defendant also appeals the decree and that appeal ends without being withdrawn.
